scope: Student Operations backend cases, repeatable initial migration and Xero document discovery/download foundation

liveReadOnlyPreview.warning: Snapshot only; rerun preview immediately before apply. The private report contains identifiers and must not be committed.

migrationRules.advisor: First nonempty advisor label ordered by invoice date, then invoice UUID; only a unique eligible account match is assigned. Raw label remains on case.
migrationRules.college: Normalized Levenshtein score >= 0.70; competing candidates within 0.05 or different matched colleges across invoices are left unassigned.
migrationRules.invoices: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED and PAID cached transactions with verified matching student reference. Deleted/voided excluded; unlinked transactions reported, never guessed.
migrationRules.repeatSafety: Tenant migration lock, per-student savepoints, existing-case skip, unique migration key and invoice association constraints.
migrationRules.documentDiscovery: Apply queues deduplicated invoice, credit note and contact discovery jobs. No live Xero requests occur in migration.

endpoints.writeContract: Create/update/link require Idempotency-Key; update also requires recordVersion. Lists accept page/limit (maximum 100).
endpoints.security: Tenant RLS using sophia_runtime_app; case management permission; assigned primary advisor access; separate document metadata/content permissions; downloads reauthorize after provider request and are audited.

documents.implemented: Xero originals with Sophia metadata, source identity/provenance, durable leased retry jobs and authorized bounded download proxy. No public provider URLs exposed.
documents.blocker: Current Xero authorization lacks accounting.attachments.read. Reconnect after deployment; actual attachment availability/count remains unverified.
documents.coverage: Accounting API invoice, credit note and contact attachments only. Prepayments/overpayments retain contact discovery, not invented attachment endpoints. Other Xero Files/bank-transaction associations require separate inventory and scopes.
documents.s3Recommendation: Later private operational mirror, retaining Xero originals: Block Public Access, SSE-KMS, checksum/version provenance, malware quarantine, retention rules and authorized short-lived access. Not provisioned or implemented in this change.
documents.limitations: Download endpoint is attachment-only, not an inline preview. No upload/delete, automatic document classification, required-document checklist, S3 mirror or full workflow automation yet.

rollout: Use Node 22 and install locked dependencies in a trusted operator checkout; operator scripts require the tsx development dependency.

Review pending migrations and take the normal backup before running the existing migration runner with owner credentials. 071_student_case_management.sql requires the earlier case foundation migrations and BM colleges schema. Do not use owner credentials for the API/worker.
Build/deploy Runtime with migration 071 applied. No deployment was performed during this task.
From sophia-runtime, with OWNER_DATABASE_URL securely configured: npm run cases:migrate -- --customer-id 33ed40a6-7f2b-407c-aab2-de76b1cb45a8 --report /private/tmp/cases-preview.json

Review missing invoice links, archived student, advisor mapping and college decisions before applying. Then use the same command with --apply and a separate private report path. Inspect requires_review results; repeat safely after correcting conflicts.

Reconnect Xero to grant accounting.attachments.read. Run npm run cases:documents -- --customer-id 33ed40a6-7f2b-407c-aab2-de76b1cb45a8 using Runtime non-BYPASSRLS credentials and Xero encryption configuration.

Schedule the bounded worker repeatedly with a single worker per tenant/connection and monitor discovery job errors/rate limits. If it ran before reconnect, requeue failed discovery through the case endpoint.
Verify live case/invoice counts, access boundaries and real documents before enabling the case UI. UI implementation is separate.

verification.integrationCoverage: Actual PostgreSQL migration, preview/apply/rerun, multiple cases, idempotency, optimistic concurrency, tenant/advisor isolation, invoice link protection, document queue processing, paginated metadata and authorized download with mocked Xero.
